verses.original: Μετὰ τοῦτο εἶδον τέσσαρας ἀγγέλους ἑστῶτας ἐπὶ τὰς τέσσαρας γωνίας τῆς γῆς κρατοῦντας τοὺς τέσσαρας ἀνέμους τῆς γῆς ἵνα μὴ πνέῃ ἄνεμος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς μήτε ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης μήτε ἐπὶ πᾶν δένδρον
verses.transliteration: Meta touto eidon tessaras angelous hestōtas epi tas tessaras gōnias tēs gēs kratountas tous tessaras anemous tēs gēs hina mē pneē anemos epi tēs gēs mēte epi tēs thalassēs mēte epi pan dendron
verses.literal: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth holding back its four winds so that no wind would blow on land or - sea or on any tree
verses.literalPt: E DEPOIS destas coisas vi quatro anjos que estavam sobre os quatro cantos da terra, retendo os quatro ventos da terra, para que nenhum vento soprasse sobre a terra, nem sobre o mar, nem contra árvore alguma.

verses.original: καὶ εἶδον ἄλλον ἄγγελον ἀναβαίνοντα ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς ἡλίου ἔχοντα σφραγῖδα Θεοῦ ζῶντος καὶ ἔκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ τοῖς τέσσαρσιν ἀγγέλοις οἷς ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἀδικῆσαι τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν
verses.transliteration: kai eidon allon angelon anabainonta apo anatolēs hēliou echonta sphragida Theou zōntos kai ekraxen phōnē megalē tois tessarsin angelois hois edothē autois adikēsai tēn gēn kai tēn thalassan
verses.literal: And I saw another angel ascending from the east . . . with the seal of the living God And he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea
verses.literalPt: E vi outro anjo subir do lado do sol nascente, e que tinha o selo do Deus vivo; e clamou com grande voz aos quatro anjos, a quem fora dado o poder de danificar a terra e o mar,

verses.original: λέγων Μὴ ἀδικήσητε τὴν γῆν μήτε τὴν θάλασσαν μήτε τὰ δένδρα ἄχρι σφραγίσωμεν τοὺς δούλους τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: legōn Mē adikēsēte tēn gēn mēte tēn thalassan mēte ta dendra achri sphragisōmen tous doulous tou Theou hēmōn epi tōn metōpōn autōn
verses.literal: Do not harm the land or sea or trees until we have placed a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Não danifiqueis a terra, nem o mar, nem as árvores, até que hajamos assinalado nas suas testas os servos do nosso Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἐσφραγισμένων ἑκατὸν τεσσεράκοντα τέσσαρες χιλιάδες ἐσφραγισμένοι ἐκ πάσης φυλῆς υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Kai ēkousa ton arithmon tōn esphragismenōn hekaton tesserakonta tessares chiliades esphragismenoi ek pasēs phylēs huiōn Israēl
verses.literal: And I heard the number of those who were sealed 144,000 . . . . . . . . . from all the tribes of Israel
verses.literalPt: E ouvi o número dos assinalados, e eram cento e quarenta e quatro mil assinalados, de todas as tribos dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: Ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰούδα δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐσφραγισμένοι ἐκ φυλῆς Ῥουβὴν δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐκ φυλῆς Γὰδ δώδεκα χιλιάδες
verses.transliteration: Ek phylēs Iouda dōdeka chiliades esphragismenoi ek phylēs Rhoubēn dōdeka chiliades ek phylēs Gad dōdeka chiliades
verses.literal: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 . . . were sealed from the tribe of Reuben 12,000 . . . from the tribe of Gad 12,000 . . .
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Judá, havia doze mil assinalados; da tribo de Rúben, doze mil assinalados; da tribo de Gade, doze mil assinalados;

verses.original: Ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσὴρ δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐκ φυλῆς Νεφθαλὶμ δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐκ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ δώδεκα χιλιάδες
verses.transliteration: Ek phylēs Asēr dōdeka chiliades ek phylēs Nephthalim dōdeka chiliades ek phylēs Manassē dōdeka chiliades
verses.literal: from the tribe of Asher 12,000 . . . from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000 . . . from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000 . . .
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Aser, doze mil assinalados; da tribo de Naftali, doze mil assinalados; da tribo de Manassés, doze mil assinalados;

verses.original: Ἐκ φυλῆς Συμεὼν δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐκ φυλῆς Λευὶ δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰσσαχὰρ δώδεκα χιλιάδες
verses.transliteration: Ek phylēs Symeōn dōdeka chiliades ek phylēs Leui dōdeka chiliades ek phylēs Issachar dōdeka chiliades
verses.literal: from the tribe of Simeon 12,000 . . . from the tribe of Levi 12,000 . . . from the tribe of Issachar 12,000 . . .
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Simeão, doze mil assinalados; da tribo de Levi, doze mil assinalados; da tribo de Issacar, doze mil assinalados;

verses.original: Ἐκ φυλῆς Ζαβουλὼν δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰωσὴφ δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐκ φυλῆς Βενιαμὶν δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐσφραγισμένοι
verses.transliteration: Ek phylēs Zaboulōn dōdeka chiliades ek phylēs Iōsēph dōdeka chiliades ek phylēs Beniamin dōdeka chiliades esphragismenoi
verses.literal: from the tribe of Zebulun 12,000 . . . from the tribe of Joseph 12,000 . . . and from the tribe of Benjamin 12,000 . . .
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Zebulom, doze mil assinalados; da tribo de José, doze mil assinalados; da tribo de Benjamim, doze mil assinalados.

verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ ὄχλος πολύς ὃν ἀριθμῆσαι αὐτὸν οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο ἐκ παντὸς ἔθνους καὶ φυλῶν καὶ λαῶν καὶ γλωσσῶν ἑστῶτες ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Ἀρνίου περιβεβλημένους στολὰς λευκάς καὶ φοίνικες ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta eidon kai idou ochlos polys hon arithmēsai auton oudeis edynato ek pantos ethnous kai phylōn kai laōn kai glōssōn hestōtes enōpion tou thronou kai enōpion tou Arniou peribeblēmenous stolas leukas kai phoinikes en tais chersin autōn
verses.literal: After this I looked and saw a multitude too large . . . . . . to count from every nation and tribe and people and tongue standing before the throne and before the Lamb They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands
verses.literalPt: Depois destas coisas olhei, e eis aqui uma multidão, a qual ninguém podia contar, de todas as nações, e tribos, e povos, e línguas, que estavam diante do trono, e perante o Cordeiro, trajando vestes brancas e com palmas nas suas mãos;

verses.original: καὶ κράζουσιν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγοντες Ἡ σωτηρία τῷ Θεῷ ἡμῶν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ καὶ τῷ Ἀρνίῳ
verses.transliteration: kai krazousin phōnē megalē legontes Hē sōtēria tō Theō hēmōn tō kathēmenō epi tō thronō kai tō Arniō
verses.literal: And they cried out in a loud voice - Salvation to our God who sits on the throne and to the Lamb
verses.literalPt: E clamavam com grande voz, dizendo: Salvação ao nosso Deus, que está assentado no trono, e ao Cordeiro.

verses.original: Καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι εἱστήκεισαν κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ἐπὶ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai pantes hoi angeloi heistēkeisan kyklō tou thronou kai tōn presbyterōn kai tōn tessarōn zōōn kai epesan enōpion tou thronou epi ta prosōpa autōn kai prosekynēsan tō Theō
verses.literal: And all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures And they fell facedown . . . . . . . . . . . . before the throne and worshiped God
verses.literalPt: E todos os anjos estavam ao redor do trono, e dos anciãos, e dos quatro animais; e prostraram-se diante do trono sobre seus rostos, e adoraram a Deus,

verses.original: λέγοντες Ἀμήν ἡ εὐλογία καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ ἡ σοφία καὶ ἡ εὐχαριστία καὶ ἡ τιμὴ καὶ ἡ δύναμις καὶ ἡ ἰσχὺς τῷ Θεῷ ἡμῶν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: legontes Amēn hē eulogia kai hē doxa kai hē sophia kai hē eucharistia kai hē timē kai hē dynamis kai hē ischys tō Theō hēmōn eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: saying Amen Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever Amen
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Amém. Louvor, e glória, e sabedoria, e ação de graças, e honra, e poder, e força ao nosso Deus, para todo o sempre. Amém.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπεκρίθη εἷς ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων λέγων μοι Οὗτοι οἱ περιβεβλημένοι τὰς στολὰς τὰς λευκὰς τίνες εἰσὶν καὶ πόθεν ἦλθον
verses.transliteration: Kai apekrithē heis ek tōn presbyterōn legōn moi Houtoi hoi peribeblēmenoi tas stolas tas leukas tines eisin kai pothen ēlthon
verses.literal: Then one of the elders addressed me These in - white robes he asked who are they and where have they come from
verses.literalPt: E um dos anciãos me falou, dizendo: Estes que estão vestidos de vestes brancas, quem são, e de onde vieram?

verses.original: Καὶ εἴρηκα αὐτῷ Κύριέ μου σὺ οἶδας Καὶ εἶπέν μοι Οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἐρχόμενοι ἐκ τῆς θλίψεως τῆς μεγάλης καὶ ἔπλυναν τὰς στολὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐλεύκαναν αὐτὰς ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ Ἀρνίου
verses.transliteration: Kai eirēka autō Kyrie mou sy oidas Kai eipen moi Houtoi eisin hoi erchomenoi ek tēs thlipseōs tēs megalēs kai eplynan tas stolas autōn kai eleukanan autas en tō haimati tou Arniou
verses.literal: Sir . . . I answered you know So he replied These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb
verses.literalPt: E eu disse-lhe: Senhor, tu sabes. E ele disse-me: Estes são os que vieram da grande tribulação, e lavaram as suas vestes e as branquearam no sangue do Cordeiro.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτό Εἰσιν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ λατρεύουσιν αὐτῷ ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου σκηνώσει ἐπ’ αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: dia touto Eisin enōpion tou thronou tou Theou kai latreuousin autō hēmeras kai nyktos en tō naō autou kai ho kathēmenos epi tou thronou skēnōsei ep’ autous
verses.literal: For this reason . . . they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them
verses.literalPt: Por isso estão diante do trono de Deus, e o servem de dia e de noite no seu templo; e aquele que está assentado sobre o trono os cobrirá com a sua sombra.

verses.original: οὐ πεινάσουσιν ἔτι οὐδὲ διψήσουσιν ἔτι οὐδὲ μὴ πέσῃ ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ὁ ἥλιος οὐδὲ πᾶν καῦμα
verses.transliteration: ou peinasousin eti oude dipsēsousin eti oude mē pesē ep’ autous ho hēlios oude pan kauma
verses.literal: Never again will they hunger and never . . . will they thirst nor will the sun beat down upon them nor any scorching heat
verses.literalPt: Nunca mais terão fome, nunca mais terão sede; nem sol nem calma alguma cairá sobre eles.

verses.original: ὅτι τὸ Ἀρνίον τὸ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ θρόνου ποιμανεῖ αὐτούς καὶ ὁδηγήσει αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ ζωῆς πηγὰς ὑδάτων καὶ ἐξαλείψει ὁ Θεὸς πᾶν δάκρυον ἐκ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: hoti to Arnion to ana meson tou thronou poimanei autous kai hodēgēsei autous epi zōēs pēgas hydatōn kai exaleipsei ho Theos pan dakryon ek tōn ophthalmōn autōn
verses.literal: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd . . . He will lead them to springs of living water and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes
verses.literalPt: Porque o Cordeiro que está no meio do trono os apascentará, e lhes servirá de guia para as fontes das águas da vida; e Deus limpará de seus olhos toda a lágrima.
